Maya: Quick sync — can we do a 30m studio run-through tomorrow 10:00am PST for the webinar? Need slide order, demo failover, and audio/video checks. @Liam @Alex @Sophia @Nina
Liam: 10:00 PST works for me. I'll bring the benchmark slides and two calling points on cost vs latency.
Alex: Good for me. Need ~15m for the live demo — can we give me 10:20 start so I have time to warm up GPUs?
Sophia: Ops can run the mic check at 09:45 and a stream checklist at 09:50. Please have presenters join the Zoom 15m early.
Nina: I'll validate screen-share + recording. Where will the fallback clip live?
Maya: We'll host fallback on S3. Alex, can you upload by EOD? Also I put a short run-of-show below — please call out changes.
Maya: ```
10:00 - check-in & mic check (all)
10:05 - intro + goals (Maya) 5m
10:10 - benchmark narrative (Liam) 10m
10:20 - live demo + guided prompts (Alex) 15m
  fallback: pre-recorded demo clip (if live fails)
10:35 - audience Q&A / routing (All) 18m
10:53 - next steps + CTAs (Maya) 7m
```
Alex: I'll upload fallback to https://internal-s3.redwood/demo-fallback.mp4 by 6pm PT. Also want to test Redwood Console trace on the demo path.
Liam: Adding two quick appendix slides for cost/perf tradeoffs — will drop in the deck and in the shared drive by EOD.
Sophia: Ops note: we'll simulate a failover at 10:25 to test graceful degradation (route to cheaper model variant). Need Alex to confirm model variants + tokens.
Alex: Confirmed — primary: rdx-large, fallback: rdx-medium-quant. I'll add the model names to the deck speaker notes.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created and sent to attendees. Reminder set 30m before start.
Maya: tiny ask — can someone run an inbound lead routing smoke test during QA? Want to ensure form -> CRM mapping works before we go live.
Nina: I'll run the routing test (submit test leads) and post results in the doc.
Liam: thumbs up — will bring a 1-slide lead capture playbook for the close.
Maya: Awesome. If no objections I'll lock the 10:00 slot and ask speakers to join at 09:45. See you there :thumbsup:
Alex: 👍
Sophia: 👍
Nina: 👍
Liam: 👍
Maya: Thanks everyone!
